plate_findings.evidence: Dilation of the intrahepatic ducts by CT scan

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Axial abdominal CT panel from a figure captioned 'Dilation of the intrahepatic ducts by CT scan' in a case series of patients with Clonorchis sinensis infection presenting with obstructive jaundice; dilated branching intrahepatic ducts are visible, matching the clonorchiasis bile duct dilatation finding. B: Reformatted CT panel of the same figure showing the intrahepatic biliary tree in a patient with clonorchiasis and obstructive jaundice; dilated intrahepatic ducts correspond to the captioned manifestation. C: Second axial CT panel in the same figure, showing dilated intrahepatic ducts (and gallbladder) in the clonorchiasis patient with obstructive jaundice described in the article. D: Reformatted CT panel of the same clonorchiasis case, demonstrating the dilated intrahepatic biliary tree described in the figure caption.
